Name: Fancy Farm
Author: williambeepbeep
Description:
[size=1]This file replaces the Farm.xnb file in your maps folder (C:\GOG Games\Stardew Valley\Content\Maps\ for the GOG version, C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Content\Maps\ for Steam, by default). It is for version 1.05 of the game, and won't work with later versions, I'm told. Please make a backup of your original Farm.xnb file before replacing it.[/size]

[size=3]The farm has been widened, the bodies of water have been removed and replaced with a pond behind the house. There are 4 new cave entrances that work as shortcuts to the mines, the desert, the beach and the bath house. A few other small aesthetic changes have been made as well.

[/size]If you do not want the shortcuts, you can download the optional file instead. It is the same map, without the shortcuts.

[i]
there was a bug in the initial release that teleported you into a wall when coming out of the farm cave. only 3 people downloaded that version, but it has been fixed.[/i]
